notes: Japan routes. routes.acquisitionSummary: au online-only plan: 0 yen base fee, pay-per-use toppings. Official spec: if no paid topping purchased for 180+ days, service may be suspended then contract cancelled (suspension-warning email first; cannot buy toppings while suspended).

keep.action: Buy any paid topping once per 180 days. Cheapest always-available topping 250 yen (2026-09 JP media, official提供条件書-based); povo-gacha promos can lower to ~100 yen/180d. Domestic SMS receive free.

routes.chinaActivation: BLOCKER: signup requires eKYC with Japanese identity documents (mynumber/driver license) and a Japanese address — not viable for typical overseas users.
routes.wifiCalling: au VoLTE/VoWiFi supported on capable devices.
routes.roamingSms: International roaming exists as paid topping; receiving SMS abroad unverified for 0-yen state — 验证中.

routes.tariffSummary: 0 yen base; keep = 1 topping/180d (from 250 yen). SMS receive free domestically.
guideSteps: Set 170-day reminder; buy cheapest topping each cycle.

routes.acquisitionSummary: Japan Voice SIM: real JP number (070/080/090), unlimited FREE incoming SMS worldwide, incoming calls free, no contract. ¥4,455 pay-today (10% promo from ¥4,950) + ¥1,430/mo. Worldwide delivery available; designed for use outside Japan.

keep.action: Subscription model — ¥1,430/mo keeps number active; incoming SMS free worldwide including outside Japan (official marketing).

routes.chinaActivation: Worldwide delivery + activate-from-abroad is the product's stated purpose. Only Voice+Data 5G SIM/eSIM products support international roaming (one-off enablement fee).
routes.wifiCalling: n/a — service works via roaming, not dependent on Wi-Fi Calling.
routes.roamingSms: Incoming SMS free worldwide (official). Outgoing SMS charged separately.
routes.tariffSummary: ¥1,430/mo, real JP number, free incoming SMS worldwide. The foreigner-friendly JP-number route.
guideSteps: Order Voice SIM with worldwide delivery (¥4,455 today + ¥1,430/mo).
Enable international roaming (one-off fee) during activation for 5G products.
Receive verification SMS anywhere at no per-message cost.

routes.acquisitionSummary: Voice+Data SIM on docomo network, from ¥2,980/mo (5GB) + ¥5,500 activation fee. Real JP number, full English signup, no Japanese bank account required.

keep.action: Subscription model — monthly billing keeps number. Premium-priced; value is English support + docomo reliability, not cost.
